_doc: Plugin settings. Copy to <workspace>/forge/settings.json to override per run (only humans edit it). The quality gates and behavioral evals run in the Jenkins pipeline; this plugin only imports their verdict (scripts/jenkins_result.py).

jenkins._doc: Default location of the pipeline's summary.json for `jenkins_result.py import` when none is given, e.g. https://jenkins.example.com/job/hms/lastCompletedBuild/artifact/quality-gates/results/after/summary.json. Credentials come only from JENKINS_USER + JENKINS_TOKEN in the environment.

cost._doc: max_tokens: Claude token budget for the plan self-check and pilot projection (0 = none). usd_per_mtok: {"input":..,"output":..,"cache_creation":..,"cache_read":..} to report USD; prices change, so none are hardcoded.
